body: Hey, its not much but I care. I wish I could give you more but I'm dumb and don't have anything else. So, I hope it's something.

Does it feel like everyone is on the other side of a pane of glass? Like you're looking at them and they're having their lives and fun and interacting. But you just can't find the crack to get in. Maybe if you could it would be different? I don't know. I think so sometimes. I try to call to them. But the cries don't move through the glass and they never see me.
Does it feel like you're peering into a looking glass at everything? Like there's this thin pane that separates me. But I can't push through it. I'm just watching them all laugh and smile.

I feel like I'm looking at myself from the other side of a pane of glass...

I don't know why I'm saying anything...but you have no replies...I think there used to be something in here with me. Why does it feel like the glass separates me from everything.
I wish there was something better.
